scope: Physical continuum kernel moments fitted to a published GALPROP output; no harmonic or transport rerun
model: I(nu)=integral F(nu/nu_c) dA(ln nu_c); A is a positive amplitude-weighted joint energy-field measure

representation_guard.grid: native nodes union 401 log-spaced band nodes
representation_guard.type: sampled numerical triangle-envelope constraint, not continuous-frequency bound

solver_accuracy: Solved at 1e-8 tolerances, or AlmostSolved with primal residual<1e-7 and duality gap<1e-8 or nonnegative primal objective<1e-8. All undergo independent physical-unit guard and positivity checks; coefficients need not be unique.
fit_objective: equal fractional least squares on training nodes for every model; no injected noise
coefficient_constraints: nonnegative atomic witness on fixed Lobatto nodes, no truth-dependent scaling or test-set selection
split: even original-file indices plus both band boundaries train; all other odd indices withheld
numerical_rank_note: rank at relative 1e-10 in column-normalized response; not noise-resolved physical identifiability
physical_limits: absorption and target physical-model discrepancy unbounded
fitted joint moments do not separate electron energy from B_perp
witness truncation is not GALPROP true-ensemble truncation
no observational noise, channel response, beam or inference accuracy claim
